sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated disbelief at being late on the very first day and a strong urge to fix it immediately.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: You've got to be kidding me. Today of all days?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels openly exasperated and panicked at the bad timing, with a frustrated disbelief that her already stressful first day is getting even worse.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Okay, okay. Don't panic. Fast walk, transfer, survive.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is trying to steady herself with brisk, self-motivating determination, masking rising stress and urgency with an upbeat, take-charge attitude.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Made it! Barely! I am never trusting that line again.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels breathless relief and triumphant frustration at having arrived just in time, still keyed up from the morning’s chaos but trying to turn it into a joking complaint.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Year one, class three... end of the hall, right?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s breathless and slightly anxious from rushing, but staying upbeat and focused as she checks the classroom location and tries to keep herself together.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s breathless and embarrassed about being late, but still trying to sound cheerful and make a confident, friendly first impression despite the rush.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a burst of embarrassed panic that instantly turns into self-aware, upbeat humor as she tries to cover her mistake and keep the moment light.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is mortified and flustered, but trying to cover her embarrassment with self-deprecating humor and a forced, upbeat attitude.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: What kind of map prints north in six-point font?!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s flustered and embarrassed, but mostly venting frustrated disbelief at the absurd mistake with her usual energetic, self-mocking style.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.text: Come on, come on... please let the teacher be nice.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and anxious from her string of mistakes, but still pushing herself forward with hopeful, pleading determination that the teacher will be forgiving.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Please tell me you're also in 1-3 and not judging me too hard.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed but is trying to recover with humor and hopeful friendliness, quietly desperate for reassurance that this awkward start won’t define her.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Then lead the way, hero. I'll owe you my life for at least one lunch break.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels relieved and amused, with her embarrassment easing into playful gratitude and a quick, friendly trust in Miyu.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered but relieved to have finally arrived, and she’s trying to recover her confidence by sounding cheerful and polite despite the embarrassment.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed and sheepishly amused, but also relieved that the teacher is taking her mishap in stride rather than making it worse.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Thank you! I swear this is not my usual brand.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed but relieved, trying to laugh off her string of mishaps with self-aware, good-natured humor now that the worst of the panic has passed.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Okay. New term status: messy start, but not a total disaster.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels sheepish but relieved, trying to laugh off the chaos and reassure herself that the day is still salvageable.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

gpt.rationale: The sequence is broadly expressive and socially forward in an extroverted way, but several upbeat happiness sprites are used for embarrassment, sarcasm, and apology where a more mixed or flustered expression would fit better.

claude.rationale: Extroverted personalities express frustration, embarrassment, and anxiety visibly and openly, but happiness is used indiscriminately across moments of panic, humiliation, and self-criticism where an expressive character would show visible frustration or sheepishness instead.
